decision: Re-seed the AGENTS.md managed-section ratchet (166 lines / 16530 bytes) to carry the #3785 hook-runtime lockout card

governingRule.description: Deliberate AGENTS.md growth is accepted only by raising the matching plan.policy.agentsMdBudget line in a reviewed diff (#645); no other route to green is permitted (#3156)

alternativesConsidered.option: Ship the doc only and leave AGENTS.md untouched
Fold the pointer into an existing managed card
Trim an unrelated card to stay under the ratchet

whyWinner: A session locked out on exit 127 cannot run any deft verb, so a tracked AGENTS.md card is the only channel that still reaches it. The ratchet is a strict no-growth seed, so any card at all requires re-seeding; the card was cut to 4 lines and the ratchet re-seeded to exactly the new size with zero slack.
revisitTrigger: When the managed section is restructured toward the 8 KB north star, fold this card into a consolidated why-am-I-blocked section and lower the ratchet
